[[File:Lok Sabha constituencies of India.png|thumbnail|400px|Lok Sabha constituencies of India]][[United Progressive Alliance]] is an Indian political party coalition led by [[Indian National Congress]].

==Seat sharing summary==
For the [[2014 Indian general election]], the [[United Progressive Alliance|UPA's]] is an alliance led for [[Indian National Congress]] with following parties:
